task: Remove Brazil-only structured-data scope from global producer acquisition SEO
impact: Prevents search engines from receiving an explicit Brazil-only service-area signal on the main producer landing while preserving local discovery pages as optional segments rather than Cutinapp identity.
evidence: Audit found PRODUCER_SEO JSON-LD declaring Service.areaServed as BR on the global /for-producers landing.
Changed the global producer Service areaServed from BR to Worldwide; no city was substituted as a new global fallback.
The general /event and root discovery SEO remain city-independent; /eventos local routes derive locality only from an explicit URL segment.
No Search Console/GA4 integration is available in this run, so impressions, CTR, indexation, trial conversion and MRR were not invented.
CI status was not yet reported for commit 80c0794a at the time of this cycle; production validation remains pending.
next: Verify CI/deploy for 80c0794a and production JSON-LD, then audit eventSeo, SeoHead, sitemap generation and public production/event schemas for hidden BR/city/locale defaults before expanding global/local landing inventory.
